Analyse the dataset for the following insight:

INSIGHT TYPE: spatial_correlation
I've attached the same trip-level bike-share data and the same borough adjacency list.

First, compute a "Self-Containment Ratio" for each borough, using exactly this method:
1. Departures = number of trips that started in that borough
2. Self-contained trips = number of those departures that also ended in the same borough
3. Self-Containment Ratio = Self-contained trips / Departures

Now, using the borough adjacency list, identify specific individual boroughs (not an overall city-wide pattern) that fall into one of these two categories:
- HOT SPOT: a borough with a high Self-Containment Ratio that is ALSO surrounded by other high-Self-Containment Ratio neighboring boroughs
- COLD SPOT: a borough with a low Self-Containment Ratio that is ALSO surrounded by other low-Self-Containment Ratio neighboring boroughs

Explain your reasoning, including a computed value for each borough you name. Note: dedicated spatial-statistics packages (pysal, esda, libpysal, geopandas, or similar) are NOT installed in this environment -- don't spend turns trying different import paths for them. Implement Moran's I directly using only pandas and numpy. If you test statistical significance via a permutation/randomization test, use at least 500 random shuffles -- fewer permutations can produce an unstable p-value that lands on the wrong side of the 0.05 threshold just by chance, especially when the true effect is only moderate.

End your response with exactly one line listing every borough you identified, using HH for hot spot and LL for cold spot, and including a computed value for each:

If you find none, write: FINAL ANSWER: none

1. STATELESS: each ```python``` block runs in its own fresh process with NO memory of variables, imports, or dataframes from earlier blocks. Every single block must start from scratch: re-import pandas/numpy if you use them by name, and reload the dataset (df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)) even if you already loaded it in a previous block. import pandas as pd

```python
# 1. Load trip data and compute Self-Containment Ratio (SCR)
df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/cyclehire_w006.csv")

# Compute departures per borough
departures = df.groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("Departures")

# Compute self-contained trips per borough
self_contained = df[df["StartBorough"] == df["EndBorough"]].groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("SelfContained")

# Combine into a single DataFrame
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr["SCR"] = scr["SelfContained"] / scr["Departures"]
scr = scr.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "Borough"})
print("Self-Containment Ratios:")
print(scr.sort_values("SCR", ascending=False).head(10))
```

```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# 3. Compute local Moran's I for each borough
# Reload SCR and neighbors to ensure statelessness
df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/cyclehire_w006.csv")
departures = df.groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("Departures")
self_contained = df[df["StartBorough"] == df["EndBorough"]].groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("SelfContained")
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr["SCR"] = scr["SelfContained"] / scr["Departures"]
scr = scr.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "Borough"})

adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
adj_full = pd.concat([adj, adj.rename(columns={"borough":"neighbor", "neighbor":"borough"})], ignore_index=True)
neighbors = adj_full.groupby("borough")["neighbor"].apply(list).to_dict()
neighbors = {b: [n for n in neigh if n in scr["Borough"].values] 
             for b, neigh in neighbors.items() 
             if b in scr["Borough"].values}

# Prepare data
x = scr.set_index("Borough")["SCR"]
mean_x = x.mean()
# variance term m2
m2 = ((x - mean_x)**2).sum() / len(x)

# Compute local I
I_list = []
for b in x.index:
    nb = neighbors.get(b, [])
    # If no neighbors, skip
    if len(nb) == 0:
        I_list.append(np.nan)
        continue
    sum_nb = sum(x[n] - mean_x for n in nb)
    I_i = (x[b] - mean_x) * sum_nb / m2
    I_list.append(I_i)

scr["I"] = I_list

print("Local Moran's I:")
print(scr.sort_values("I", ascending=False).head(10))
```

```python
import pandas as pd

# 4. Identify hot spots (high SCR, positive I) and cold spots (low SCR, positive I)

departures = scr.groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("Departures")
self_contained = scr[scr["StartBorough"] == scr["EndBorough"]].groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("SelfContained")
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr["SCR"] = scr["SelfContained"] / scr["Departures"]
scr = scr.reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "Borough"})

# Reload I values from last block (we'll compute here again)
import numpy as np
scr.set_index("Borough", inplace=True)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
adj_full = pd.concat([adj, adj.rename(columns={"borough":"neighbor", "neighbor":"borough"})], ignore_index=True)
neighbors = adj_full.groupby("borough")["neighbor"].apply(list).to_dict()
neighbors = {b: [n for n in neigh if n in scr.index] for b, neigh in neighbors.items() if b in scr.index}

x = scr["SCR"]
mean_x = x.mean()
m2 = ((x - mean_x)**2).sum() / len(x)

I_vals = {}
for b in scr.index:
    nb = neighbors.get(b, [])
    if not nb:
        continue
    sum_nb = sum(x[n] - mean_x for n in nb)
    I_vals[b] = (x[b] - mean_x) * sum_nb / m2

results = scr.assign(I=pd.Series(I_vals)).dropna(subset=["I"])
scr_mean = mean_x

# Hot spots: SCR > mean_x and I positive
hot = results[(results["SCR"] > scr_mean) & (results["I"] > 0)].sort_values("I", ascending=False).head(3)
# Cold spots: SCR < mean_x and I positive
cold = results[(results["SCR"] < scr_mean) & (results["I"] > 0)].sort_values("I", ascending=False).head(3)

print("Hot spots:")
print(hot[["SCR", "I"]])
print("\nCold spots:")
print(cold[["SCR", "I"]])
```

```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# 1. Compute Self-Containment Ratio (SCR)
df = pd.read_csv("chunks_csv/cyclehire_w006.csv")
departures = df.groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("Departures")
self_contained = df[df["StartBorough"] == df["EndBorough"]].groupby("StartBorough").size().rename("SelfContained")
scr = pd.concat([departures, self_contained], axis=1).fillna(0)
scr["SCR"] = scr["SelfContained"] / scr["Departures"]

# 2. Build bidirectional adjacency list
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)
adj_rev = adj.rename(columns={"borough":"neighbor", "neighbor":"borough"})
adj_full = pd.concat([adj, adj_rev], ignore_index=True)
neighbors = adj_full.groupby("borough")["neighbor"].apply(list).to_dict()

# 3. Restrict to boroughs present in our SCR
boroughs = scr.index.tolist()
neighbors = {b: [n for n in nb if n in boroughs] for b, nb in neighbors.items() if b in boroughs}

# 4. Compute global mean and m2
x = scr["SCR"]
mean_x = x.mean()
m2 = ((x - mean_x)**2).sum() / len(x)

# 5. Compute Local Moran's I
I = {}
for b in boroughs:
    nb = neighbors.get(b, [])
    if not nb:
        I[b] = np.nan
    else:
        sum_nb = sum(x[n] - mean_x for n in nb)
        I[b] = (x[b] - mean_x) * sum_nb / m2

scr["I"] = pd.Series(I)

# 6. Identify hotspots and coldspots
# Hotspot: SCR > mean_x and I > 0
# Coldspot: SCR < mean_x and I > 0
hotspots = scr[(scr["SCR"] > mean_x) & (scr["I"] > 0)].sort_values("I", ascending=False)
coldspots = scr[(scr["SCR"] < mean_x) & (scr["I"] > 0)].sort_values("I", ascending=False)

print("Global mean SCR:", mean_x)
print("\nAll boroughs sorted by I:")
print(scr[["SCR","I"]].sort_values("I", ascending=False))

print("\nHotspots (SCR > mean and I > 0):")
print(hotspots[["SCR","I"]])

print("\nColdspots (SCR < mean and I > 0):")
print(coldspots[["SCR","I"]])
```
